messages:
maria: quick heads up — ran into a goroutine leak in the Go SDK generator when the context passed to the constructor cancels during the handshake. happens in our sample app that does auth refresh mid-start.
aj: can you paste the smallest repro you have? also which sdk version?
maria: using v0.13.2 from internal vendor. repro is tiny:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 50*time.Millisecond)
gen, err := client.NewGenerator(ctx, model, opts...)
// we immediately call gen.Stream or gen.Next after NewGenerator returns
// ctx often times out before handshake completes
```
when ctx times out we still see a goroutine stick around reading from network.
ryan: ugh — this rings a bell. I think NewGenerator starts the read loop before the handshake future completes, and we don't gate goroutine lifetime on the handshake ctx.
aj: can you try a quick patch locally? in NewGenerator, defer starting the read goroutine until after handshake.Done() or the constructor returns an error.
maria: tried that — moving start to after the initial handshake finishes prevents the leak. also checked: adding a select{ case <-ctx.Done(): return nil } in constructor prevents spinning.
ryan: nice. probably needs a unit test that cancels during handshake. can you open a PR with the test + fix? label it "generator: ctx-handshake-leak" and add me + aj as reviewers.
aj: also consider changing constructor signature doc: call out that ctx controls both handshake and subsequent stream lifetime (or choose to accept a separate ctx for lifecycle). API parity note: other SDKs (py/js) already gate read loop on handshake — go slipped.
maria: yup I'll do the PR. one more question: do we want to change behavior to accept a background ctx and a separate Cancel for stream lifetime? might be breaking.
ryan: prefer minimal fix now (gate goroutine), then follow-up RFC if we want to change constructor semantics. post PR to eng-runtime and devex so people who hit this know.
ciaran-bot: scheduled ci/test on PR #5432 — flaky test runner will retry once :robot_face:
maria: thanks — will send in the next hour. :thumbsup:
